cohort: Preterm infants born at less than 30 weeks of gestation or with a birth weight less than 1,000 g, divided into those with Relative Adrenal Insufficiency (RAI) and those without RAI.
finding: Hyponatremia is a common symptom among preterm infants with Relative Adrenal Insufficiency (RAI), and its pathogenesis is likely vascular hyperpermeability, preceding other clinical symptoms.
